th: ขอโทษ, เสียใจ

ex.en: No matter how busy, he exercises.

ex.zh: 这件衣服很好看,不过有点贵。

ex.py: Nǐ cāi tā duō dà le?

ex.py: Qǐng gàosu wǒ nǐ de dìzhǐ.

ex.en: You are right.
